trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task to do for it. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, with the 100% completion trophy taking the biggest share. Work through the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this pops during the story. It is the first trophy most players will earn and it cannot be missed. Just play the opening as directed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock as you play, so there is nothing extra to hunt down here. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter as a safety net, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Several side characters open up in this chapter — Andy, Randy and Tyrone — so start their questlines when their icons appear. The chapter trophy itself is automatic.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The big bank-vault jobs unlock in this chapter, so start working on vaults and gang operations while you play through it. The chapter trophy pops on its own.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to close the campaign and earn the gold. Free roam stays open afterwards, so almost everything else can be cleaned up after the credits. Check the 100% completion list under Progress once the story is done.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission when it appears in the campaign. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed. No extra preparation is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission when it appears in the campaign. It is a story beat, so it pops on its own and cannot be missed. Just follow the mission objectives.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission when it appears in the campaign. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed. No side activity is required for it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission when it appears in the campaign. It pops on its own as you play through the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission when it appears in the campaign. It unlocks automatically as part of the story. The airport itself matters for other trophies later, so note its layout while you are there.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission when it appears in the campaign. It pops on its own as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress after you finish the story. You do not need literally everything: for example only 15 of the 18 card sets, 70 of the 80 Challenges and 300 of the 397 stunts count toward it. It is the hardest and longest trophy, so treat the checklist itself as your cleanup list and work it top to bottom.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between tall buildings, and 25 base jumps. You only need a little over half, so skip the ones that frustrate you. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts and find spots via Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

locations.name: Stunt Jumps (130)
locations.where: Jump off ramps, bridges, construction sites and more. Find them via Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

locations.name: Under the Bridges (202)
locations.where: Fly an aircraft through tight gaps under bridges.

locations.name: Knife Flights (40)
locations.where: Flip your airplane 90 degrees and slip through narrow gaps between tall buildings around Vice City.

locations.name: Base Jumps (25)
locations.where: Leap off the tallest peaks and buildings in Leonida and drop through checkpoints before parachuting onto the target.

trophies.locations_note: 397 stunts in total, trophy needs any 250. No published per-spot list of all 397 exists in the sources — the in-game Stunt Spots map filter is the way to find them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them. Most will happen naturally while you explore, so check the list early and mop up whichever types you have not touched.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The two ranges are Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows.

locations.where: Port Gellhorn, Kelly County.

locations.where: Balsero, Vice City.

trophies.locations_note: 42 challenges across the two ranges. Most have three difficulty tiers to gold; some stay locked until you meet their conditions, shown on the map.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, and each location also has time trials — 42 in total — which the 100% checklist wants as well. Find every location under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida; winning the same race twice does not count. There are 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, so this trophy falls out of the longer grind. Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing, and upgrade your car at Mod Shops if its rating is holding you back.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on he asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2 kg: fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod, but there are plenty to borrow in the area if you do not own one yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game — there are 4 video games in total, and three of them are playable on the TV at home. You only need to complete one, not all four, so pick whichever you find easiest. This is one of the quickest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Andy's quests and then her final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and opens from Chapter 3, so switch to Lucia when her icon appears. Work through her missions as they unlock and the trophy pops at the end of the line.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand, which starts in Chapter 1: clear 7 shipwrecks for him, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes. Dive the wrecks as they are marked and return to Kenton between jobs. The trophy pops when his final mission is done.

locations.where: Individual wreck locations are not published in the sources — location unconfirmed, check the source guide. Final mission: Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Billy's quests at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. Billy's strand opens from Chapter 2. Work through his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — whole questlines, not 8 single missions. Stranger icons appear across Leonida as you explore; pick them up when you pass and finish each strand before moving on. The 100% checklist does not require these, so they are usually the last side content left after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by delivering all 16 cars on his wish list, starting from Chapter 3. Each requested car has a location to find it in; deliver them one by one and the trophy pops when the final mission completes. Keep an eye out for wish-list cars while you are out driving anyway.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand, which is Jason-only and opens from Chapter 3: destroy the labs he marks for you and then complete his final mission, Spin On This. His questline also feeds the kitty-litter lab locations other guides list, so follow his markers as they appear.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and read this before you leave Chapter 1. Early in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads to the balcony: follow her and accept the prompt. That balcony meditation raises your counter but is not marked as a spot like the others, and it cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, so it is the one possibly-missable trophy on the list. For the other 17, wait for the final zen animation to play at each spot, and track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only, and the exact animal is still being confirmed by the community, so check a current hunting guide before you set out rather than guessing. Take Bret's jobs when they appear and follow his markers.

There are 18 sets in the game, so pick the three whose cards you find first and finish those; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops on the way there. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count. Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges — in-game feats listed under Progress > Challenges, each with its own requirement. You can skip the 30 hardest, since only 50 count here (70 are needed for 100%). Pick off the easy ones as you play: driving, combat and exploration challenges stack up fast without much deliberate grinding.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it by escaping the heat zone. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives you 4 stars, so this often pops on its own during vault jobs. If you are hunting it deliberately, a good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without your wanted level clearing between them — stay wanted the whole time. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not fire instantly.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app, so scan every new vehicle you see. It should happen naturally during the story, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops. Track it under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. Aim for gang members at their illegal operations — guides report it does not seem to register on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger airliner at Vice City International Airport and fly away with it. The easiest one is docked at terminals E3/E4; the trophy unlocks once you are about 1 km away from the airport. Expect heavy police attention on the runway, so go in fast and get airborne quickly.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Guides point to Mile Zero Air Station as the place to find one. Getting in and out of a guarded base with a tank is the hard part — plan your escape route before you grab it, and save first.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3, so this cannot be done early. Save manually beforehand — there is no mission replay — then go in quiet, keep out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops partway through the full vault grind. Vaults unlock properly during Chapter 4 through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, so do not expect to finish this early.

trophies.locations_note: Trophy needs 5 vaults robbed and escaped; 100% wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks appear on the roads around Leonida — hit one, grab the cash, and break away from the police before the heat builds. It pairs naturally with the vault and gang-operation robberies, so it often pops while you are working on those.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the map fog is fully cleared — all 52 named areas of the state. Drive, fly and sail into every corner rather than fast-travelling everywhere; the map fills in as you physically visit places. It pairs well with the stunt, WAiNK and vehicle-discovery grinds, so do your exploring while you chase those.

The 6 official regions are Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 gang operations exist in total, so you have plenty of targets. One hit per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so keep going after this pops. Operations are marked as you discover them; hit a different gang's turf each time.

trophies.locations_note: One hit per gang is enough for the trophy; 100% wants all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed by the community — do not trust an unverified walkthrough for this one. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and one guide reports the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach as the spot, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed. Try ordering a cocktail there with a view and check back once the community pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed by the community — the exact trigger is unconfirmed, so no verified step-by-step exists yet. The description suggests smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, which points to driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front. Try it at a showroom and, if it does not pop, wait for the community to confirm the exact spot.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the 3 key valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — and then lose the police. This is a smash-and-grab with a follow-through: grab all three valuables, get out, and break the wanted level to finish it. Save before you go in.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so your progress doubles. Keep training both until each hits the cap and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Criminal Profile actions are the small choices and deeds that shape your in-game reputation — robberies, fences, and other illicit activity all feed it. It builds up over a normal playthrough, so keep playing the crime side of the game and check your profile total in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed by the community — the exact unlock is unknown and no guide has published a verified method yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but that is only a hint, not a confirmed step. Do not follow an unverified method for this one; it will be added here once the community confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed by the community — the exact unlock is unknown and no guide has published a verified method yet. The description suggests witnessing something strange out in the world, but that is only a hint. Keep exploring Leonida's odd corners and check back once the community confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method still being confirmed by the community — the precise method is still being confirmed, so no verified step-by-step exists yet. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, which suggests a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact conditions are unconfirmed. Wait for the community to pin it down rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). Marked bills come from robberies, and only bills laundered through contacts count — spending them elsewhere does nothing. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000, so this pops on the way to A Long Road; keep fencing after every big job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything counts. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style and spend as you play; between gear, outfits and ammo it adds up on its own. If you are close near the end, buy the most expensive items you still want and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, for $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000, and Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each adds one parking spot for vehicles registered at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, which also feeds the Scooter Bros trophy.
trophies.locations_note: All 8 via the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which delivers your repaired vehicles to you for a small fee. Register a vehicle you are driving at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot — buying garages adds more spots. Ten different vehicles is all it takes.
